summary: In India, stay in cash for now, though Hindustan Copper is the favourite if buying; in America, buy JPMorgan Chase cautiously. Analysts note that ten dollars cannot cover any US IPO minimum, and in India a mainboard IPO lot needs about fourteen thousand rupees. They also say buying Reliance shares on Zerodha has no brokerage but still costs around thirty-eight rupees in fees plus twenty percent tax on short-term gains.
